audit_actor_valid.name: audit_actor_valid
audit_actor_valid.value: ("vehicle_audit"."operation" = 'legacy_imported' AND "vehicle_audit"."actor_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("vehicle_audit"."operation" <> 'legacy_imported' AND "vehicle_audit"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

image_dimensions_valid.name: image_dimensions_valid
image_dimensions_valid.value: ("vehicle_images"."width" IS NULL AND "vehicle_images"."height" IS NULL) OR ("vehicle_images"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "vehicle_images"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "vehicle_images"."width" > 0 AND "vehicle_images"."height" > 0)

vehicle_public_fields.name: vehicle_public_fields
vehicle_public_fields.value: "vehicles"."status" NOT IN ('published', 'reserved', 'sold') OR (coalesce(length(trim("vehicles"."brand")), 0) > 0 AND coalesce(length(trim("vehicles"."model")), 0) > 0 AND coalesce("vehicles"."price_cents", 0) > 0 AND "vehicles"."availability_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "vehicles"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
